# Trade

> Two-party, both-confirm, atomic item and currency trading.

- Package: `Trade` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Economy](Economy.md), [Item](Item.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Trade")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Trade`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/TradeService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Trade = GaxiaServer.Trade
```

### Functions

- `Trade.Request(from: Player, to: Player): (string?, string?)`
- `Trade.GetActiveTrade(player: Player): string?`
- `Trade.GetTrade(tradeId: string): Trade?`
- `Trade.AddItem(player: Player, tradeId: string, itemId: string, count: number): (boolean, string)`
- `Trade.RemoveItem(player: Player, tradeId: string, itemId: string, count: number?): (boolean, string)`
- `Trade.AddCurrency(player: Player, tradeId: string, currency: string, amount: number): (boolean, string)`
- `Trade.RemoveCurrency(player: Player, tradeId: string, currency: string, amount: number?): (boolean, string)`
- `Trade.IsConfirmed(player: Player, tradeId: string): boolean`
- `Trade.Confirm(player: Player, tradeId: string): (boolean, boolean, string)`
  Returns (ok, executed, message). The swap fires when BOTH sides are confirmed.
- `Trade.Cancel(player: Player, tradeId: string): boolean`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Trade.OnUpdate` — `Signal<string>`
  (tradeId) on Request, every offer change and every Confirm
- `Trade.OnComplete` — `Signal<string, boolean>`
  (tradeId, success) after the swap ran (Confirm) or the trade was cancelled (success = false)

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type Offer = { items: { [string]: number }, currencies: { [string]: number }, confirmed: boolean }
export type Trade = { id: string, a: Player, b: Player, offers: { [number]: Offer } }
```
